lead.headline: Five calls made, three still open, first place up for grabs
lead.dek: Poochinski slid CeeDee Lamb into Chris Olave’s spot, Cherry Blossom went to Trevor Lawrence, and the morning wire was busy. The first-place game opens at 56.5% Bad things man bad things.
lead.pull: Settled: Lamb in, Olave out. Still open: AB81, which has never made a move.
body: The developing stories mostly developed. Poochinski settled its receiver question by moving CeeDee Lamb into Chris Olave’s spot, then added Chris Godwin Jr. at 6:19 a.m. Cherry Blossom picked Trevor Lawrence (19.77) over Bo Nix and put Jaylen Warren in for Christian McCaffrey. deeboliciouskins filled Malik Nabers’ spot with Tyler Warren, and the champ swapped Breece Hall for Omarion Hampton.

The morning wire was busy too. Santa Clara’s Finest added Stefon Diggs at 6:20 a.m. and Hunter Henry three minutes later. Bad things man bad things grabbed Omar Cooper Jr. at 7:55 a.m. Five moves since Saturday night, and none of them from AB81.

Which brings us to the first-place game. Bad things man bad things has 68.96 in the bank and projects for 177.01. Poochinski projects for 170.84 with the full Lamb-and-Gibbs lineup still to play. That’s 56.5% Bad things, and a game the Dallas stack can flip by itself.

Still open at kickoff: Cherry Blossom’s flex, where Parker Washington (14.93) waits behind Jameson Williams (9.76), and AB81’s two holes with Mark Andrews (8.78) as the only bench answer. Next update after the early games.

quick_hits.headline: Poochinski made its call at WR
quick_hits.body: CeeDee Lamb in for Chris Olave, Chris Godwin Jr. on the roster at 6:19 a.m. The first-place lineup is set.

quick_hits.headline: Cherry Blossom goes with Lawrence
quick_hits.body: Trevor Lawrence (19.77) starts at quarterback over Bo Nix, and Jaylen Warren takes McCaffrey’s spot. The coin flip with deeboliciouskins is 48.6% to 51.4%.

quick_hits.headline: Santa Clara’s Finest loaded up before breakfast
quick_hits.body: Stefon Diggs at 6:20 a.m., Hunter Henry at 6:23 a.m. Down 72.62 to nothing, it projects for 153.95 against Big Stric Energy’s 175.68. 28.3% to win.

quick_hits.headline: AB81 goes into kickoff with two holes
quick_hits.body: Mike Evans and DeVonta Smith are both Out and both in the lineup. Mark Andrews (8.78) is on the bench. Zero moves all season. The clock says 10:00 a.m.

w8-m1.headline: Big Stric Energy protects a 72.62 head start
w8-m1.blurb: 175.68 to 153.95 projected. Santa Clara’s Finest needs its new pickups and Lamar Jackson to all hit at once.

w8-m2.headline: Banked points vs. the Dallas stack
w8-m2.blurb: Bad things man bad things has 68.96 already and projects for 177.01. Poochinski is at 170.84 with everything still to play.

w8-m3.headline: The closest game on the board
w8-m3.blurb: deeboliciouskins 155.7, Cherry Blossom 154.2. Parker Washington on the Cherry Blossom bench is the last open question.

w8-m4.headline: The champ is up 17.3 and favored
w8-m4.blurb: 159.66 to 140.75 projected. AB81’s two open lineup spots are the difference.

w8-r8-s5.headline: Will AB81 make its first move of the season?
w8-r8-s5.blurb: DeVonta Smith is Out and starting. Mark Andrews (8.78) is the bench answer. The decision locks at 10:00 a.m.

w8-r4-s8.headline: Washington or Williams at flex?
w8-r4-s8.blurb: Parker Washington projects for 14.93, Jameson Williams for 9.76. In the closest game of the week, that gap matters.

2026-11-01-m2.blurb: Fills the hole Olave left without touching the first-place lineup.

2026-11-01-m3.blurb: A real receiver for a team that needed one, projected 12.64.

2026-11-01-m4.blurb: Hunter Henry for Juwan Johnson is an upgrade at tight end.

2026-11-01-m5.blurb: Omar Cooper Jr. for Isaiah Likely. Depth for a first-place fight.

2026-11-01-m1.blurb: A running back for a kicker. Roster math, not a lineup move.
